0.content: Crucabena was The Knave before Arlecchino and head of the House of the Hearth, a famed Harbinger who fought with Hydro. The children called her "Mother". She seemed perfect: smiling, gentle, full of stories, yet her stories were atrocities told as fairy tales, and she treated the House as an experiment. She trained orphans and made them duel until one survivor could be crowned "king" and her heir; maimed survivors went to Dottore or on suicide missions. She favoured Peruere for her strange fire and tortured her own daughter Clervie as an example to would-be runaways. A year after Clervie's death, on the same ground, Peruere killed her. The world called it matricide, and Arlecchino has never corrected it.

1.content: Crucabena's daughter, brought to the House at six, cheerful, stubborn and passionate. She and Peruere were the only children who saw through "Mother". She dreamed of a real family where no one was sacrificed, tried again and again to run or expose the truth, was tortured each time, and urged the other children to fight to draws. She and Peruere watched the moon and promised to see Snezhnaya's aurora together. At sixteen, out of hope, she let Peruere kill her in a duel, calling death the only freedom left to her.

2.comment: Arlecchino: The House of the Hearth under "Father"
2.content: An orphanage of Khaenri'ahn origin that takes in war orphans from across Teyvat and turns promising ones into Fatui agents; its members take the surnames Snezhevich and Snezhevna. In Fontaine its face is the Hotel Bouffes d'ete in the Vasari Passage, registered under a false identity. Arlecchino's rules: disputes are settled by duels, no longer fatal; betrayal is punished; emotions must be mastered ("Never be their slave"); every child must value their own life. She holds barbecues and birthday feasts, lets adolescents keep their vanities and slang unless they endanger a mission, and says the House "begs favors from no one; like a spider, we hunt for what we want."

3.content: Arlecchino took in Lyney and Lynette over ten years ago after killing the head of the Lefevere family, to whom Lynette had been trafficked. Freminet came to the House under Crucabena; Arlecchino later destroyed the moneylenders who ruined his family and returned the pendant he had made for his mother, learning in the process that Crucabena had lied to him. When Lyney asked for a Delusion to stay by his sister, she angrily refused; he later earned a Pyro Vision. She wants him to be the next "king", because he is brave, talented and cherishes his family, and tells him a throne needs only conviction and the strength to act on it.

4.comment: Arlecchino: Furina, Neuvillette and the Hydro Gnosis
4.content: In Fontaine Arlecchino posed as a Fontaine-born diplomat. Using Childe's imprisonment as an opening, she requested tea with Furina and Neuvillette, and when Neuvillette refused to release Childe she said she respected Fontaine's courts. At the Opera Epiclese she exposed Furina's bluff about the prophecy. Earlier she had stalked Furina through the Court at night and attacked; seeing genuine terror and no Gnosis, she left. When the prophecy struck Poisson her people led the relief, earning Navia's gratitude, and after the crisis Neuvillette gave her the Hydro Gnosis to take to Snezhnaya.
